task_contract.coil_axis_discrepancy: Docstring says smallest axis; executable source selects last remaining dimension <=64, else last remaining. Explicit hint may not collide with kx/ky.
task_contract.geometry_boundary: Argument/H5 spacing versus placeholder [1,1,1] mm distinct; no calibrated patient orientation or slice/time geometry established. Source grader checks no affine match for short_recon_grappa.
task_contract.operation: Complex k-space mode indexes each frame as (kx,ky,coils), calibrates on explicit or center ACS, interpolates missing ky with pygrappa when undersampled, IFFT and root-sum-of-squares magnitude; real image dataset can pass through without GRAPPA, fully sampled k-space can skip GRAPPA, and a failed frame can zero-fill.
task_contract.reference_boundary: Public mode/grader rule only; channel eligibility never automatic reveal. Private/full-sampled image and actual reconstructed_nifti absent.
